title: The Amplitude-Growth Degeneracy and Implied A_s Diagnostic for Background-Inert Modified Gravity (Kolhatkar & Sahoo)
efc_relevance: Proves an A_s-D_0 degeneracy in background-inert modified-gravity classes (coincident f(Q) as worked example) and derives an fσ8 consistency test that exposes it; a λ_0·√(Q·Q_0) correction inflates σ8_0. Direct bearing on EFC's perturbation-sector predictions (FA2 μ(a)<1): any EFC fit that does not break the A_s-D_0 degeneracy can over-claim a σ8 signature that is actually a primordial-amplitude artefact.
ledger_action: Add to WP3 Falsification Protocol as a mandatory diagnostic for every EFC μ(a)<1 fit; update gap ledger_perturbationsector_valley with explicit A_s-D_0 break requirement; cross-reference arXiv:2605.00450 (CosmicFlows-4++ fσ8) and framework:fR-Starobinsky2007 (FA2 sign-discriminator) — without A_s diagnostic, FA2 is degenerate.
